items.title: 4.1.5.1 Breadth-First Search Algorithm (BFS) in Graph (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of BFS with the zoo example (PDF 102-103).

blocks.text: BFS ek algorithm (qadam ba qadam tareeqa) hai jo trees ya graphs jaise data structures ko explore aur traverse karta hai, yaani har node par ja kar dekhta hai. Yeh pehle current (abhi wale) “level” (gehrai) ke saare nodes dekhta hai, phir agle level par jata hai.

Sochiye aap dosto ke saath zoo dekhne gaye hain. Zoo mein janwaron ke bohat se enclosures (ahaate) hain jo raaston se jure hain. Aap saare janwar dekhna chahte hain, is liye aisa plan chahiye ke koi ahata reh na jaye. BFS yahi kaam karta hai. Is mein queue istemal hoti hai, jo baari ka intezar karte logon ki line jaisi hai.

items: Darwaze se shuru: aap zoo ke entrance (darwaze) se shuru karte hain; yeh pehla ahata hai jo aap dekhenge. Map (naqsha) mein is shuruati jagah ko “start node” kehte hain.

Queue se ahaate dekhna: Organized rehne ke liye entrance ko queue mein daal dein. Queue ki madad se ahaate usi order (tarteeb) mein dekhe jate hain jis mein woh milte hain. Jo naya ahata mile use line (queue) mein laga dein, taake baari baari dekh sakein.

Pehla ahata dekhna: queue ke sab se aage wala ahata dekhein. Janwar dekhne ke baad map mein us se jure qareeb ke ahaate dhoondein; inhein "neighboring enclosures" (parosi ahaate) kehte hain. Phir in parosi ahaaton ko queue mein jor dein (enqueue) taake baad mein dekh sakein.

Queue ka agla ahata: ab queue ke agle ahaate par jayein aur yahi kaam dohrayein: janwar dekhein, us ke parosi ahaate dhoondein aur queue mein jor dein. Is tarah qadam ba qadam saare ahaate dekhe jate hain.
Queue khali hone tak: jab tak queue mein koi ahata baqi hai, chalte rahein. Queue khali ho jaye to matlab zoo ka har ahata dekha ja chuka hai.

blocks.prompt: Zoo wale tareeqe mein stack ki bajaye queue kyun?
blocks.explanation: Queue ahaate usi order mein deti hai jis mein woh mile, is liye qareeb ke ahaate door walon se pehle dekhe jate hain, yaani level ba level.

items: BFS: start node queue mein; aage se nikalo, dekho, parosi queue mein joro; queue khali ho to ruk jao.
